blocks.text: Protect Mobile Applications, User Data and Connected Services
Cybersentinels Consulting assesses mobile applications for weaknesses affecting authentication, local data
Our mobile application penetration testing helps organizations understand risks across the application package

sections.heading: Mobile Security Extends Beyond the Application Screen

blocks.text: Mobile applications interact with operating-system capabilities, local storage, device identifiers, external links
We evaluate the application through static and dynamic techniques, review runtime behavior

sections.heading: Mobile Application Security Areas We Assess

blocks.text: Depending on scope and platform, assessment may include:
Application Package and Configuration
Review application metadata, permissions, exported components, build settings
Local Data Storage
Assess whether sensitive data is stored in files, databases, preferences, logs, caches
Authentication and Session Handling
Evaluate login, token management, session behavior, device binding
Platform Interaction
Review inter-process communication, deep links, URL schemes, intents, clipboard use
Network Communication
Assess transport protection, certificate validation
Code and Runtime Protections
Review exposure to tampering, debugging, reverse engineering
Business Logic and Authorization
Test workflows and user roles for unauthorized access, manipulation or abuse
Supporting APIs
Assess backend endpoints used by the mobile application when explicitly included in scope
Third-Party Components
Identify security-relevant libraries, SDKs and integrations observable within the approved
1. Platform and Scope Confirmation
Confirm Android or iOS coverage, application builds, environments, test users, backend scope
2. Static Analysis
Review the application package, configuration, resources
3. Dynamic Analysis
Observe application behavior at runtime and assess storage, communication, platform interaction
4. Authentication and Workflow Testing
Evaluate roles, sessions, authorization and business processes
5. Backend and API Testing
Assess supporting endpoints where authorized and included in the agreed scope
6. Validation and Risk Analysis
Confirm findings, document evidence and consider technical and business impact
7. Reporting and Retesting
Provide remediation guidance and verify fixes within the agreed retest scope

sections.heading: When to Test a Mobile Application

items: Before public release or major version updates
After introducing new authentication or sensitive functionality
When backend APIs or platform integrations change
Before enterprise, regulatory or app-distribution reviews
As part of a recurring secure-development program
After reports of data leakage, tampering or account compromise
